info.title: Avari.Jobs API
info.description: Website mutations require a CSRF header with the avari_csrf cookie value. Extension sessions use Bearer tokens. Pending accounts may also access Telegram registration challenges and connection availability; blocked accounts may only access /me and /auth/logout. The calendar feed uses a separate secret read-only token and is only available for active accounts. Changes require user confirmation. There is no administrative HTTP API.

post.summary: Create secret-bound extension Telegram login (five minutes)
post.description: No cookies. If Origin is supplied it must be a chrome-extension or moz-extension origin. Polling and completion require the initiating extension's secret header. Only active accounts with a linked Telegram can log in. Web and extension challenges cannot be exchanged. The secret and issued token must remain in the service worker; never put them in URLs or content scripts.
